DIVISION TWO 
 
B185017 
People 
 
 
(Not for Publication) 
 
 
 
v. 
 
 
 
Morales 
 
The judgment is modified to strike the section 12022, subdivision (a)(1) 
principal armed enhancement on count 3, to stay the sentence for robbery in 
count 3 pursuant to section 654, and to reflect a consecutive term of one 
year eight months for carjacking in count 2 and a total sentence of 16 years 
eight months.  The trial court is directed to correct the minute order of 
sentencing to delete the reference to a section 12022, subdivision (a)(1) 
enhancement on count 1.  The trial court is further directed to prepare a new 
abstract of judgment reflecting this correction as well as the modifications 
to the judgment set forth herein, and to forward the amended abstract of 
judgment to the Department of Corrections.  In all other respects, the 
judgment is affirmed. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Boren, P.J. 
 
 
 
 
We concur: Doi Todd, J. 
 
 
 
 
 
Ashmann-Gerst, J.

v. 
 
 
Steven H. 
 
Probation condition 15 is modified to read, "Do not associate with anyone 
known to you to be a member of any gang.  'Gang' is defined by Penal Code 
section 186.22, subdivision (f)."  Probation condition 15A is modified to 
read, "Do not participate in any type of activity known to you to be 
conducted by members of any gang or related to any gang.  Do not wear 
clothing or insignia or obtain tattoos known to you to be related to any 
gang.  'Gang' is defined by Penal Code section 186.22, subdivision (f)."  In 
all other respects, the judgment is affirmed.
